description: The recursive Wen Wang Gua (文王卦) / Yijing interpretive apparatus — the full traditional toolkit for casting and reading a hexagram: Six Relatives (六亲), Na Jia (納甲) line-to-branch mapping, Five Elements (五行) producing/controlling dynamics, palace (卦宫) position, Self and Usage lines (世爻/用神), moving lines and the transformed hexagram, classical line-text hermeneutics, and dramatized Six-Relatives narrative. A method-skill: a menu of interpretive moves to improvise a living reading from, NOT a form to fill out. Use when asked to consult the Yijing, cast a hexagram, run Wen Wang Gua on a situation or on the chat itself, or read a question through Chinese hexagram divination. Triggers on: 'consult the Yijing', 'cast a hexagram', 'I Ching reading', 'Wen Wang Gua', '六亲', '納甲', 'run the WWG framework on our chat', 'what does the oracle say'. Kin: /san-shi-diagnostic, /chronosemiology, /darshana, /oracular-voice, /elemental-phenomenology.
